title: Billsticker
html_source: A billsticker is someone who posts advertisements on walls. Bloom also refers to Boylan as a billsticker in Ithaca. It’s interesting that Corley thinks he saw Bloom and Boylan spending time together in a pub…on its face it seems unlikely, but it’s possible they were discussing one of Molly’s tours.
